svg.title: ReactorSockets :: Raw profile :: class model
svg.desc: Enterprise Architect style UML class diagram of the ReactorSockets Raw profile as implemented: the L2 public contract, RawReactor's nested private types, the internal L1 transport wrappers and the internal L0 core modules.
svg.text: «layer» L0 — ReactorSockets.Core (internal, shared by all three profiles)
RawReactor internals — nested private types and the legality matrix
+ SendTo(link : LinkId, destination : Source, payload : ReadOnlySpan<byte>) : Result
- TryReserve(handle, slot, data, out payloadOffset) : bool
Single-threaded and pull-driven (ADR 0002): nothing is delivered except in
response to a consumer call, and every mutating member throws if called from
a thread other than the one that constructed the Reactor, or re-entrantly
from inside a Pump already in progress.
TryReserve states the arena admission policy once — the reservation, both
refusals with their accounting, and the two counters true of any admitted
Payload. It stays in Raw rather than moving to Core: a Session reserves at a
different point in its pipeline (ADR 0010) and must refuse differently, with
+ Register(socket : Socket, onReadable : Action, onWritable : Action? = null) : void
wiped at the start of every Frame
One buffer, wiped at the start of every Frame, and every span handed
out is carved from it. A share-holder's first request each Frame always
escapes its read share — the share bounds a reader that loops within a
Frame, not a single read. Raw reads each Link once per Frame, so a
ShareExhausted refusal is unreachable through its public surface.
Generic over the occupant because Capacity counts Share-holders:
Links in Raw, Peers in a Session (ADR 0014). Raw binds T to LinkSlot.
TryAdd answers null when full and never throws, so the Reactor keeps
both of its own policies — throw on Bind, defer on accept — at L2.
Twelve (operation, kind) pairs stated once, so no kind is ever inferred
from the absence of the others. LinkSlot.Kind is abstract, so a new kind
cannot compile without declaring itself — which sends its author here.
The discard arm refuses rather than permits: a missing row fails closed.
holds an offset, not a span
one per operation, each with its outcome
